regression_pins_1ms.basis: a regression guard, not a qualification (the lead's ruling): twice the development error at 1 ms, at least 100 floors and 1e-13 for dimensionless quantities; tests/unit/test_species_regulated_availability_regression.py

scope.worlds: A4 (R-feedback): two 2 pL cells on 4 pF patches facing held baths, joined by a contact of 2e-8 m/s with its gate held at 1; a state of Na in both, its complement on the contact (side both, basal 0.2); 2 s, started from the reference's own state at 50 ms (after the contact's voltage transient); the contact sits at the edge of @3's explicit-rate bound at 1 ms. A fast arm at k_on + k_off = 900/s. A5 (R-cell): one cell with a K-leak population read at once from a neutral regulator with D150's turnover and a production pulse; 1 s.
scope.not_covered: pumps and gated channels (the references model neither); horizons beyond 2 s (A4) and 1 s (A5); A10, the first consumer (its crossing level above the A.3 commitment limit is never reached: refuse it or mark it unreachable, the references agent's note, for A10's own protocol); A2's states against R-state (milestone 2's closed forms stand); restart, windows, batches and the bitwise items, which are tier tests
scope.gpu: CPU-only in version 1 (proposed, the lead's recommendation): the floors, the band's resolution and A4's fragile observables were measured on CPU; an L4 variant is a later protocol with its own development runs
scope.a1: the references agent's form: the absolute error in eps (fr.eps_error) against R-fac's exact path, not a relative-ulp criterion (too strict in deep Hill tails), within an a priori bound per point

attempt_rule: D150's: one judged run from a clean execution snapshot of main into a new directory. An infrastructure ending (a timeout at the launcher's runtime limit, a runtime kill, an OOM kill, a signal, or an incomplete results.json) is rerun once from the same snapshot into a new directory; a failed criterion is a verdict, not a retry
disclosures: The band [1.7, 2.3] was set around the scheme's order 2 (the lead's ruling) with the development orders, 1.97 to 2.08 on resolved pairs, in view

The judged observables (V, the amounts and U wherever resolved; s, a_eff and F only where every pair is resolved) and each rule's minimum resolved pairs (the development count less one) are rules applied to the development run, so they were fixed with its results in view

The registered deltas (2e-5 and 5e-6) are the development deltas rounded up on a 1-2-5 grid; the development deltas were set from that run's own finest errors (a plateau at 10 times the finest error in V)

The rounding-scale rule (N eps max|U| for U; 1e-13 for s, a_eff and F) was written after the development record showed A4's uncoupled U pair at 2.33, with errors of 8.6e-13 and 1.7e-13 s at accumulated rounding; the rule excludes that pair, and U is reported only in that arm
A1's bound (4 + 2 f (1 - f) n (|ln x| + |ln K| + 1) eps) and the 100-floor factor were written before A1 and the dt study first ran

The development run of record comes from the snapshot of 476c6e01 and the rehearsal from main at 0448f9fc; the rehearsal's records equal the development run's bit for bit, the δ-controls apart (run at the registered δ by design)
